task.title: Founder-present Mac DigitalOcean console PAT maintenance

result.summary: Recovered the byte-identical approved local App Platform console runner, reverified the current app and web component, and proved the existing least-privilege context can open the console with a harmless constant-plus-Node-version payload. No PAT rotation or permission broadening is needed, and no other current main-visible credential-maintenance blocker remains.

tests.summary: Exact runner blob equality, local dependency checks, App Platform listing, active-deployment and instance inspection, and bounded console execution all passed.

review.summary: No application code changed; the recovered ignored runner is byte-identical to repository authority.

zero_write_audit.summary: Console payload printed only a fixed marker and Node version; it ran no SQL, read no production user data, and exited zero.

unexpected_findings: The legacy physiqueos-audit context is recorded in a prior handoff as returning 401, but the standing approved physiqueos-final-cutover-config context passes both read and console access.
recommended_next_step: No Founder credential action is required; preserve the existing least-privilege context and avoid speculative rotation.
